renderscope.title: RenderScope
renderscope.cpu_note: Measured CPU render/visual time · wall clock, not GPU time
renderscope.geometry_note: Estimated vertex data · batching and uploads may differ
renderscope.no_world: Enter a world to measure visible objects.
renderscope.instancing_note: Flywheel: per-mechanism visual CPU work + separate shared batch
renderscope.instance_help: Select an instance to highlight or follow it in the world.
renderscope.timeline_help: Click a frame to inspect its measured top offenders.
renderscope.heatmap_help: Color follows relative render cost in the current scene.
renderscope.heatmap_colors: Green: lower cost · yellow: higher · red: top 5%
renderscope.capture_help: Capture records real frame samples and renderer attribution.
renderscope.capture_empty: Complete a capture to inspect and export its summary.
renderscope.capture_privacy: Reports exclude player names, servers, worlds, chat and UUIDs.
renderscope.hover_help: Hover truncated values to read them. Scroll for more rows.
renderscope.settings_mode_note: Timing Only maximizes compatibility. Full counts emitted vertices.
renderscope.settings_positions_note: Positions are excluded from exports unless explicitly enabled.
renderscope.gpu_shared_note: GPU: shared Flywheel draws / completed sampled frame; no per-object GPU attribution.
renderscope.parallel_note: Visual tasks may overlap on workers; summed work can exceed frame latency.
renderscope.flywheel_geometry_note: Instanced geometry is not counted; — means unavailable.
renderscope.overview.evidence: %s per frame · %s%% of measured object CPU work
renderscope.overview.no_world_detail: Look toward the scene you want to investigate, then open RenderScope again.
renderscope.overview.paused_detail: Resume profiling above to collect a fresh picture of this scene.
renderscope.overview.wait_detail: Move around and look at nearby entities or block entities. This is not a measurement of all Minecraft rendering.
renderscope.overview.no_object_detail: Frames are arriving, but no supported object work was measured. Terrain, shaders and other work may still be expensive.
renderscope.overview.scope: This compares measured object CPU work, not all rendering or GPU time. A leader alone does not prove what lowered your FPS.
renderscope.overview.small_slice: Measured objects account for little CPU work compared with frame time. These samples do not explain the rest of the frame.
renderscope.overview.dropped: Some measurements were dropped. Treat this ranking as incomplete.
renderscope.overview.top_mods: Mods with the most measured work
renderscope.overview.mod_help: Click a mod to see which object types contributed. Percentages compare these measurements only.
renderscope.overview.mod_tooltip: %s: %s per frame, %s%% of measured object CPU work.
renderscope.overview.step_world: 1. Find object opens the leading mod's heaviest measured instance. Show in world highlights it and enables direction tracking.
renderscope.overview.step_capture: 2. Reproduce the slowdown while recording 10 seconds. Compare another capture after making your own change.
renderscope.overview.sample_progress: Collected %s frames / %s calls / %s s. A ranking needs at least %s frames, %s calls and %s seconds.
renderscope.overview.type_help: These numbers combine this type's measured instances. Scroll down and select one to locate a specific object.
renderscope.overview.mod_detail_help: Measured CPU work assigned to this registry owner. Choose an object type below, then an instance to find it in the world.
renderscope.help.tab.overview: Start here: a plain-language result, leading mods and a shortcut to the measured object.
renderscope.help.tab.mods: Compare mods by measured CPU work; select one to see its object types.
renderscope.help.tab.objects: Compare entity and block entity types, then inspect individual world instances.
renderscope.help.tab.timeline: Explore recent frame times. Select a frame to inspect the retained measurements.
renderscope.help.tab.heatmap: Color measured objects in the world by their relative CPU cost; configure the crosshair inspector here.
renderscope.help.tab.capture: Record a reproducible scene, read the summary and export a local JSON report.
renderscope.help.settings: Change profiling, measurement mode, world overlays and report privacy.
renderscope.help.capture: Record real measurements for the duration chosen in Capture. No report is sent anywhere.
renderscope.help.find: Open the leading mod's heaviest measured instance. Its position and individual CPU measurements are shown.
renderscope.help.show_world: Highlight and track that instance, then return to the game. The object itself is unchanged.
renderscope.help.wait_for_data: Wait for at least %s measured frames, %s calls and %s seconds with profiling enabled.
renderscope.help.wait_for_instance: A reliable measured instance in the current dimension is needed before showing it in the world.
renderscope.help.resume: Enable profiling and start collecting fresh measurements.
renderscope.help.quick_capture: Record 10 seconds of real gameplay, or stop the active capture. The summary opens in Capture.
renderscope.help.diagnostic: A measured-work ranking, not a confirmed cause of low FPS. It covers supported entity/block entity renderers and visual tasks. CPU intervals can overlap across workers; GPU, terrain and other rendering are not assigned to these objects.
renderscope.help.open_mod: Click to inspect this mod's measured objects.
renderscope.help.fps: Frames per second, averaged over the rolling window. Higher is smoother, but the number does not identify a cause.
renderscope.help.frame: Time between completed frames. Lower is smoother. Frame time includes work beyond the objects measured by RenderScope.
renderscope.help.average_frame: Average complete frame duration in the rolling window. A 60 FPS frame budget is about 16.7 ms.
renderscope.help.low_fps: FPS calculated from the average duration of the slowest 1% of measured frames. It describes stutters better than the average FPS alone.
renderscope.help.p50: Median frame time: half the measured frames were at or below this duration.
renderscope.help.p95: 95% of the measured per-frame values were at or below this duration. The slowest 5% may be higher. On an object detail this describes its measured CPU work, not the complete frame.
renderscope.help.p99: 99% of the measured per-frame values were at or below this duration. The slowest 1% may be higher.
renderscope.help.worst_frame: Longest complete frame in the current rolling window.
renderscope.help.cpu_average: Average measured CPU-side work per complete frame, including frames with zero calls. This is not per-call latency or GPU time.
renderscope.help.cpu_percent: This object or mod's share of the measured object CPU work. It is not a share of all frame time or a predicted FPS gain.
renderscope.help.calls: Measured renderer, render-data preparation or supported visual callbacks. More calls do not necessarily mean higher cost.
renderscope.help.instances: Distinct object instances measured in the rolling window.
renderscope.help.vertices: Only vertices observed through the standard BufferBuilder path in Full mode. Custom and instanced geometry may bypass it.
renderscope.help.vertex_data: Observed vertices multiplied by vertex-format size. This estimate is not actual GPU uploads or VRAM usage.
renderscope.help.highlight: Toggle this instance's outline in the world. Close this screen to see it.
renderscope.help.track: Show direction and distance to this instance while playing.
renderscope.help.copy_position: Copy this instance's measured X Y Z position to the clipboard.
renderscope.help.measurement_mode: Timing Only records supported CPU work. Full also observes standard geometry and shared Flywheel GPU batches when available. Shared GPU work is not divided among objects.
renderscope.overview.geometry_scope: Geometry shows only the standard path actually observed in Full mode. Zero can mean a custom or instanced pipeline bypassed the counter; it does not prove that no geometry was rendered.
renderscope.help.no_candidate: No measured object is available. Enable profiling and look toward supported entities or block entities.
renderscope.help.find_preliminary: Open this real measured instance using the early samples. The ranking is preliminary and may change; it does not establish the cause of low FPS.
renderscope.help.show_preliminary: Highlight and track this real measured instance, then return to the game. Early samples are preliminary; this is not a confirmed FPS culprit.
